decided: The rule for the program sign-off no longer says that each change has already merged, or that the brief says so. It says only what the archive guarantees: in per-proposal mode each change has passed its archive, which marks its pull request ready and leaves the merge to the user; in never mode its work is archived on its branch. The brief gains no line about it.
alternatives: add a sentence to the program brief stating that fact, chosen by the pull-request mode, which would also change the text the user signs whenever the mode changes
why: Archiving a change does not merge it, so a merged claim would misstate what the user is signing; no part of the brief wrote the promised line, and adding one would make the signed text depend on a setting.
